dict.string: Onicode uses your microphone for on-device dictation and for voice sessions you start. Voice sessions stream your audio to OpenAI through your ChatGPT-authenticated Codex account.
Agents you run in Onicode script other apps, such as System Events and Finder, when a task needs it.
Agents you run in Onicode read and change files on your Desktop when you work there.
Agents you run in Onicode read and change files in Documents when you work there.
Agents you run in Onicode read and change files in Downloads when you work there.
Agents you run in Onicode read and change files on external drives when you work there.
Agents you run in Onicode read and change files on network drives when you work there.
